title: Airport & Hospital Land Deals in Austin
summary:
*   A special closed-door meeting was held to discuss sensitive real estate matters.
*   Key discussions focused on acquiring land necessary for the future Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
*   Potential real estate transactions related to Brackenridge Hospital were also a significant topic.
